body: Both are refused now. A host must match whole; a port is compared when both sides name one. Each of these is CDX4002.

author: reek
body: fetch is a definition in Net chapter Http now, not an effect operation the foreword declares and nothing implements. The refusals are unchanged, and that is the point of this test: lint-scoped-call keys on the callee's name, so the scope gate does not care what kind of thing the name resolves to. It does mean the rows are honest -- fetching sends the request, so a caller declares Network.Write too.
